描述_EN: it is practised by people from various groups living in the south-west of china. because they live in comparative isolation in mountainous regions, these groups have developed some unique traditions. the technique used here is wax resist, similar to indonesian batik. these indigo wax-resist textiles are one distinctive manifestation of their culture.
描述_ZN: 它是由生活在中国西南部的不同群体的人所实行的。 由于他们生活在相对孤立的山区，这些群体已经发展了一些独特的传统。 这里使用的技术是蜡质抗蚀剂，类似于印度尼西亚的蜡染。 这些靛蓝蜡质的纺织品是他们文化的一种独特表现。
